svg.title: Mindfulness & Alertness in the Path of Training

g.text: Mindfulness & Alertness in the Path of Training
Practice Virtue (restraint from misconduct, seeing danger in slightest fault)
Guard Sense Faculties (restraint from grasping at themes & variations)
during activities and when observing internal phenomena,
pliant, malleable, luminous, and not brittle
is a "food" for inappropriate attention, leading to a chain of unskillful qualities and hindrances.
(e.g., walking, eating, talking, any bodily movement)
(Calming bodily & mental fabrications, focusing on impermanence)
(Focus on body, feelings, mind, mental qualities to subdue greed/distress, being ardent, alert, mindful)
\n(Sensual desire, ill will, sloth & drowsiness, restlessness & anxiety, uncertainty);\nnote right: The mind becomes conducive to concentration once hindrances are overcome.
(states of deep mental absorption)\n(Remaining equanimous, mindful, and alert within these states)
(Mindfulness is a key factor, intrinsic to Right Mindfulness & Right Concentration)
(Ending of effluents, culminating in clear knowing, freedom from clinging)
